before: A content-locked control refused every local write, including run formatting.
after: With contentLockPolicy.allowFormattingInLockedContent, an untracked local run-property or paragraph-mark write that does not hide text passes the content half of the lock. Other writes are still refused. Without the option, behavior is unchanged.
reason: The option changes only local validation. A formatting edit produces the same run-property primitives as on an unlocked control, which released participants already apply. Remote updates bypass local protection checks, so replicas with different policies converge.
